clusters.title: Japan Establishes Male-Only Succession Law for Imperial Family
clusters.summary: Japan's parliament has enacted a law that enshrines male-only succession for the imperial family, aiming to preserve the royal lineage. The new regulations maintain the exclusion of women from the throne, despite public interest in potential female successors, such as Princess Aiko. Experts express concern that this decision may threaten the future of the 1,500-year-old hereditary institution.
